{{Current events|year=2026|month=04|day=15|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****[[2026 Iran war ceasefire]]
*****[[Pakistan in the 2026 Iran war]]
******A [[Pakistan]]i delegation led by [[Chief of Defence Forces (Pakistan)|military chief]] [[Asim Munir]] arrives in [[Tehran]], [[Iran]], to facilitate the continuation of diplomacy between Iran and the [[United States]]. [https://aje.news/lxeq57?update=4494711 (Al Jazeera)]
******[[Prime Minister of Pakistan|Pakistani prime minister]] [[Shehbaz Sharif]] arrives in [[Jeddah]] to begin a four-day diplomatic trip through [[Saudi Arabia]], [[Qatar]], and [[Turkey]] to push for a second round of Iran–U.S. peace talks. [https://www.arabnews.pk/node/2640000/saudi-arabia (''Arab News PK'')]
*****The U.S. says that it has not formally agreed to extend the [[ceasefire]], although there is ongoing engagement between Iran and the U.S. towards a peace deal. [https://aje.news/lxeq57?update=4494380 (Al Jazeera)]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[2026 Strait of Hormuz campaign]]
*****The [[U.S. Central Command]] reports that ten vessels have been turned around since the start of the [[naval blockade of Iran]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/world/iran/live-blog/live-updates-us-blockade-iran-hormuz-trump-peace-talks-rcna331890/rcrd108066?canonicalCard=true (NBC News)]
****Iran's [[Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters|military headquarters]] threatens to [[Red Sea crisis|close the Red Sea]] in addition to [[Strait of Hormuz|the strait]] if the U.S. naval blockade continues. [https://aje.news/lxeq57?update=4494170 (Al Jazeera)]
***A U.S. official says that over 10,000 additional [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] personnel, including sailors aboard {{USS|George H. W. Bush||6}} and the [[11th Marine Expeditionary Unit]] on the [[USS Boxer (LHD-4)|''Boxer'' Amphibious Ready Group]], will arrive in the region later this month. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/americas/us-to-deploy-thousands-more-troops-to-middle-east-to-pressure-iran-report/3906531 (AA)]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
***[[2026 Lebanon war]]
****[[Israeli attacks on the Lebanese health sector during the Israel-Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israeli attacks on the Lebanese health sector during the Israel-Hezbollah conflict]]
*****At least three [[Health in Lebanon|paramedics]] are killed, six others are injured, and one remains missing after [[Israel]]i strikes hit [[incident response team]]s in [[Mayfadoun]], [[Nabatieh Governorate]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.lbcgroup.tv/news/lebanon-news/925119/lebanon-health-ministry-says-israel-kills-three-paramedics-in-strikes/en (AFP via LBCI)]
****[[2026 Israel–Lebanon peace talks]]
*****The [[Security Cabinet of Israel|Israeli security cabinet]] convenes and does not make a decision about a ceasefire in Lebanon, following the previous day's negotiations. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/security-cabinet-meeting-on-potential-lebanon-ceasefire-ends-without-a-decision-report/ (''Times of Israel'')] [https://www.axios.com/2026/04/15/lebanon-ceasefire-israel-trump (''Axios'')]
****At least 13 people are killed by Israeli attacks across Lebanon. [https://aje.news/lxeq57?update=4494400 (Al Jazeera)]
****[[Ministry of Public Health (Lebanon)|Lebanon's health ministry]] updates the total casualties to 2,167 killed and 7,061 injured. [https://aje.news/lxeq57?update=4494663 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] [[Chief of Staff of the Israel Defense Forces|chief of staff]] [[Eyal Zamir]] says that Israel has approved plans for the continuation of military action in both Iran and Lebanon. [https://aje.news/lxeq57?update=4494786 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***A [[drone warfare|drone strike]] in [[West Darfur]] kills three people including [[Chad|Chadian]] nationals at a [[Chad–Sudan border|border]] crossing. [https://sudantribune.com/article/312837 (''Sudan Tribune'')]
**The civil war in Sudan between the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] and [[Rapid Support Forces]] enters its fourth year. [https://apnews.com/article/sudan-war-military-rsf-anniversary-four-years-32a416bfbd680ea42edf6c0298d2617b (AP)]
*[[War on drugs]]
**[[Operation Southern Spear]], [[United States strikes on alleged drug traffickers during Operation Southern Spear]]
***Three people are killed in an [[airstrike]] carried out by the [[United States Navy]] against an alleged drug boat in the [[Pacific Ocean|eastern Pacific]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-kills-two-men-strike-eastern-pacific-2026-04-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[2026 Afghanistan–Pakistan war|2026 Afghanistan–Pakistan War]]
**[[Taliban]] [[Government of Afghanistan|authorities]] say that the Markazi High School in the [[Dangam District|Dangam district]], [[Afghanistan]], is damaged by rocket strikes from [[Pakistan]]. [https://kabulnow.com/2026/04/school-severely-damaged-in-latest-pakistani-rocket-attacks-in-afghanistans-kunar-province/ (KabulNow)]
*[[Russian sabotage operations in Europe]]
**[[Ministry of Defence (Sweden)#Ministers for Civil Defence|Swedish civil defence minister]] [[Carl-Oskar Bohlin]] reports that the [[Swedish Security Service]] had prevented a [[Cyberwarfare by Russia|cyberattack]] on a [[thermal power station]] in [[West Sweden]] in mid-2025, identifying the perpetrators as a group linked to [[Russia]]n [[Foreign Intelligence Service (Russia)|intelligence]], with no significant disruption to operations. [https://macaubusiness.com/sweden-thwarted-2025-pro-russian-cyber-attack-on-thermal-power-plant/ (AFP via ''Macau Business'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Iran war fuel crisis]]
***[[China–Russia relations]], [[China in the 2026 Iran war]], [[Russia in the 2026 Iran war]]
****[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Russia)|Russian foreign minister]] [[Sergey Lavrov]] states that [[Russia]] can supply [[Energy in Russia|energy]] to [[China]] and other countries affected by [[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis|disruptions in shipments]] through the [[Strait of Hormuz]] amid the [[2026 Iran war|Iran war]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/russia-china-lavrov-iran-war-energy-resources-6057471 (AFP via CNA)]
***[[Iraq–Syria relations]], [[Iraq in the 2026 Iran war]], [[Syria in the 2026 Iran war]]
****[[Syria]] begins loading the first [[Tanker (ship)|tanker]] carrying [[Iraq]]i [[Petroleum industry in Iraq|oil]] at the [[Baniyas Refinery]] for export by sea under a bilateral arrangement to reroute shipments amid disruptions to maritime traffic through the Strait of Hormuz. [https://www.spacewar.com/afp/260415175319.bk1949ht.html (AFP via SpaceWar.com)]
***[[Norway]] records its highest-ever [[crude oil]] [[Energy in Norway|export]] value in March, reaching 57.4 billion [[Norwegian krone|kroner]] ([[United States dollar|US$]]6.08 billion) for 56.6 million barrels, contributing to a [[trade surplus]] of 97.5 billion kroner ($10.3 billion) amid a global fuel crisis. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-04-15/norway-s-crude-exports-hit-record-value-as-oil-price-soared (Bloomberg)]
***[[South Korea]] secures imports of 273 million barrels of crude oil (by the end of the year) and 2.1 million tons of [[naphtha]] through alternative routes that bypass the Strait of Hormuz, providing several months of supply amid disruptions linked to the Iran war. [https://www.spacewar.com/afp/260415062534.k3fux5ih.html (AFP via SpaceWar.com)]
**The [[Ministry of Transport (Iraq)|Iraqi transport ministry]] announces that [[Iraqi Airways]] will resume flights to [[Dubai]], [[United Arab Emirates]], beginning tomorrow and [[Istanbul]], Turkey, on Saturday. [https://www.iraqinews.com/iraq/iraqi-airways-to-resume-flights-to-dubai-istanbul/ (''Iraqi News'')]
*The [[BBC]] announces that it will cut between 1,800 and 2,000 jobs, around 1-in-10 employees, citing the need to address "significant financial pressures". [https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/bbc-to-cut-up-to-2000-jobs-major-cost-saving-move-1236722352/ (''Variety'')]
*Shoe company [[Allbirds]] announces it will be pivoting to providing computing infrastructure for [[artificial intelligence]], with plans to rename itself to "NewBird AI". The company's shares rose nearly 600% on the news. [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/15/allbirds-bird-stock-shoes-ai.html (CNBC)]
*Funding for the [[Second Avenue Subway]] in [[New York City]] is restored by the [[United States federal government]] following the Trump administration halting funding in the midst of the [[2025 United States federal government shutdown]] and a lawsuit by the [[Metropolitan Transportation Authority]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2026/04/16/nyregion/2nd-avenue-subway-mta-trump.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Evacuations during the 2026 Iran war]], [[Iran–Sri Lanka relations]], [[Sinking of IRIS Dena|Sinking of IRIS ''Dena'']]
**[[Sri Lanka]] repatriates 238 [[Iran]]ian [[Islamic Republic of Iran Navy|sailors]] from the [[IRIS Bushehr|IRIS ''Bushehr'']] and the wrecked [[IRIS Dena|IRIS ''Dena'']], after providing temporary shelter on humanitarian grounds. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/south-asia/sri-lanka-repatriates-238-stranded-iranian-sailors-minister (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
*[[Humanitarian impact of the Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Humanitarian impact of the Sudanese civil war]]
**Donors pledge [[Euro|€]]1.3 billion (US$1.5 billion) in [[Foreign aid to Sudan|foreign aid]] for [[Sudan]] at an international conference in [[Berlin]], [[Germany]], marking the third anniversary of the beginning of [[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudan's civil war]], as participants also discuss efforts to advance [[Sudanese peace process|ceasefire negotiations]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/15/countries-pledge-1-5bn-for-sudan-crisis-as-war-enters-fourth-year (Al Jazeera)]
*[[North Korea and weapons of mass destruction]]
**[[International Atomic Energy Agency]] director general [[Rafael Grossi]] reports increased activity at multiple [[Nuclear power in North Korea|nuclear facilities]] in [[North Korea]], including the [[Nyongbyon Nuclear Scientific Research Center|Nyongbyon]] site, indicating expanded capacity to produce [[nuclear weapon]]s. [https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/world/2026/4/15/north-korea-showing-serious-increase-in-ability-to-make-nuclear-weapons-iaea-chief-1516 (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]
*[[Israel–Somaliland relations]], [[International recognition of Somaliland]]
**[[Israel]] appoints Michael Lotem as the first Israeli ambassador to [[Somaliland]], months after Israel officially recognised the breakaway region in [[Somalia]]. Lotem previously served as the Israeli [[Israel–Kenya relations|ambassador]] to [[Kenya]]. [https://aje.news/y1a2vr (Al Jazeera)] [https://garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/israel-appoints-1st-ambassador-to-somalia-s-breakaway-region-in-controversial-move (Garowe Online)] [https://horseedmedia.net/israel-appoints-first-ambassador-to-somaliland-in-controversial-diplomatic-move/420690/ (Horseed Media)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2026 Onikişubat school shooting]]
**Nine people are killed and 13 others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] [[School shooting|at a school]] in [[Onikişubat]], [[Kahramanmaraş Province]], [[Turkey]]. The perpetrator dies by suicide. It is the deadliest school shooting in Turkish history. [https://www.reuters.com/world/least-one-killed-turkey-school-shooting-ntv-reports-2026-04-15/ (Reuters)]
*[[Antisemitism in the United Kingdom]]
**Two people are arrested in [[Watford]] on suspicion of arson in an attempted attack on [[Finchley Reform Synagogue]] in [[North Finchley]], [[Greater London|London]], [[England]]. The [[Metropolitan Police]] are treating the attempted attack as a [[hate crime]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cew77rwrevdo (BBC)] [https://www.politico.eu/article/two-people-arrested-after-attempted-arson-attack-on-london-finchley-reform-synagogue/ (Politico)]
*[[Chinese intelligence activity abroad]]
**A [[Taiwan]]ese [[Judicial Yuan|court]] sentences six current and former [[Republic of China Armed Forces|military]] personnel to prison terms of four and a half to eight and a half years for [[espionage]] offenses, including organizing networks and transmitting classified information to individuals linked to [[China]]. [https://theedgemalaysia.com/node/799988 (AFP via ''The Edge'')]
*[[Corruption in Papua New Guinea]]
**[[Papua New Guinea]] tightens security at [[Papua New Guinea Defence Force|military]] bases and imposes movement restrictions after a group of soldiers sets up [[roadblock]]s in [[Port Moresby]] to protest alleged irregularities in army recruitment linked to former [[defence minister]] [[Billy Joseph]], who is under investigation. [https://www.spacewar.com/afp/260415052220.exu7cv6h.html (AFP via SpaceWar.com)]
*[[Organised crime in Indonesia]]
**[[Indonesia]]n [[Indonesian National Police|police]] announce the arrest of six suspects for [[Wildlife smuggling|trafficking]] [[Endangered species (IUCN status)|endangered]] [[Komodo dragon]]s sourced from [[East Nusa Tenggara]] and intended for export to [[Thailand]], and detain two additional individuals for [[Pangolin trade|smuggling]] [[pangolin]] scales. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/indonesia-police-arrest-six-for-komodo-dragon-smuggling (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
*[[Gabon]]ese intelligence agents arrest former [[Prime Minister of Gabon|prime minister]] and [[Politics of Gabon|opposition]] figure [[Alain Claude Bilie By Nze]] at his residence over an alleged unpaid debt linked to a 2008 public event. [https://apnews.com/article/gabon-bilie-arrested-nguema-junta-coup-bongo-89efbe037e5b484ed4bb65e2a48d67fd (AP)]
*A [[Judiciary of Kenya|court]] in [[Nairobi]], [[Kenya]], sentences a [[Chinese people in Kenya|Chinese national]] to one year in prison and imposes a fine after he pleads guilty to attempting to [[Wildlife smuggling|smuggle]] more than 2,200 ants out of Kenya without authorization. [https://www.cp24.com/news/world/2026/04/15/kenya-sentences-chinese-ant-smuggler-to-year-in-jail/ (AFP via CP24)]
*Two [[Overseas Filipino Worker|Filipino household workers]] are shot dead by their employer during a hostage incident at a residence in [[Beirut]], Lebanon, and [[Internal Security Forces|police]] arrest the suspect. [https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/2-ofws-shot-dead-by-employer-in-beirut-hostage-incident-1.500513793 (''Gulf News'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Reactions to the 2026 Iran war]]
**The [[U.S. Senate]] rejects the [[War Powers Resolution]] by a 52–47 vote in the fourth [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]]-led attempt to stop hostilities until they are authorized by the [[U.S. Congress]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-senate-republicans-block-bid-rein-trump-iran-war-powers-voting-continues-2026-04-15/ (Reuters)]
*[[2026 Hungarian parliamentary election]]
**[[Prime Minister of Hungary|Hungarian prime minister]]-designate [[ Péter Magyar]] urges [[President of Hungary|president]] [[Tamás Sulyok]] to resign as he is "unfit to serve as the guardian of legality [...] and to serve as a moral authority or a role model". [https://news.sky.com/story/hungarys-new-pm-peter-magyar-tells-unworthy-president-to-resign-13532102 (Sky News)]
*[[Christine Fréchette]] is sworn in as [[Premier of Quebec]], [[Canada]], succeeding [[François Legault]]. [https://montrealgazette.com/news/provincial-news/provincial-politics/christine-frechette-sworn-in-as-quebec-premier-promises-to-govern-with-ambition-and-determination/ (''The Gazette'')]
<!-- All news items above this line -->}}
